name: Santisteban del Puerto (Spain)
description: Square flag with a red cross throughout, with a white square at the centre and the quarters chequy of red and white and red and yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Santisteban del Puerto; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross throughout with a white square at the crossing
square at the centre of the cross
chequy of red and white in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters
chequy of red and yellow in the upper fly and lower hoist quarters
